description: This file defines the NotInOperator class, which is a filter operator used in the SuiteCRM JSON API to represent a 'NOT IN' comparison in filters. It extends a base Operator class and implements methods to return filter tags, SQL representations, validate operators, and format SQL operands.

classes.name: NotInOperator
classes.description: Represents a 'NOT IN' filter operator for JSON API filters, providing methods to generate filter tags and SQL syntax, validate inputs, and format SQL operands.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag, 'nin', used in JSON API filters.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator string, 'NOT IN'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the operator input is a string; throws InvalidArgumentException if not.

methods.name: toSqlOperands
methods.description: Wraps the operands generated by the parent method in parentheses for SQL syntax.
